Features

Wide View, Clear Voice Pickup

Meetings in larger rooms stay clear and easy to follow for people joining remotely.

Four 50MP Cameras

The quad camera system records at up to 3840 × 2160, with f/2.4 lenses and 1/1.55 inch sensors.

125° View & 8x Zoom

A wide lens takes in the table, and two telephoto lenses reach closer with 8x hybrid zoom.

Speaker-Aware Framing

Speaker tracking, auto framing, intelligent focus and smart gathering change the shot during a call.

Expandable Microphones

Sixteen microphones cover up to 10m, and four expansion microphones can be connected.

AI Audio Processing

Echo cancellation, noise suppression, automatic gain control and an audio fence clean up the room’s sound.

BYOD Over USB-B

Laptops connect to the USB-B 3.0 port with one cable to hold meetings in BYOD mode.

Overview

Android Inside, Managed With Microsoft Tools

The XBar V70 and Panel AP30 both run Android 13 with Microsoft Device Ecosystem Platform (MDEP) support. IT staff can manage them in the Microsoft Teams Admin Center, Intune or the Pro management portal. MAXHUB Pivot reports device status over the internet.

  • HDMI and USB-C sharing both reach 4K at 30fps.
  • Two HDMI outputs run at up to 4K and 60Hz, with CEC support.
  • Audio in and out ports link third-party audio equipment.
  • The RJ45 Ext port connects MAXHUB accessories such as microphones and cameras.
  • Panel AP30 can power a laptop over USB-C at up to 65W.
What's in the Kit

Bar & Panel, Linked Over One Cable

The V70 bar handles video and audio. Panel AP30 gives people a touch screen to run the meeting.

XBar V70 Video Bar

This 4.3kg bar measures 840.6 × 117.6 × 104mm and contains the cameras, microphones and speakers.

In its box
  • Power adapter and 1.5m AC cable
  • Two 3m HDMI cables
  • 3m Ethernet cable
  • Mounting components

Panel AP30 Touch Panel

The 11.6 inch touch panel has its own power supply and wakes automatically through a PIR sensor.

In its box
  • 1.5m USB-C cable
  • 7.5m Ethernet cable
  • Screwdriver
  • Power adapter and 1.5m AC cable

Connected Over RJ45

The bar’s RJ45 M Link port connects Panel AP30, and a 7.5m Ethernet cable comes with the panel.

FAQs

Common Questions on XBar V70 Kit

01What comes in the XBar V70 Kit box?

You get the XBar V70 video bar and Panel AP30. The bar is packed with a power adapter, an AC cable, two 3m HDMI cables, a 3m Ethernet cable and mounting components. The panel is packed with a 1.5m USB-C cable, a 7.5m Ethernet cable, a screwdriver, a power adapter and an AC cable.

02Which platform does the V70 run on?

Both the bar and Panel AP30 run Android 13 with Microsoft Device Ecosystem Platform (MDEP) support.

03How can IT manage the kit?

The kit works with Microsoft’s device management tools, including the Teams Admin Center, Intune and the Pro management portal. MAXHUB Pivot can also monitor its status remotely.

04At what resolution is content shared?

Local sharing over HDMI or USB-C runs at 4K and 30fps. Content shared inside a Teams meeting runs at 1080p and 30fps.

05How does BYOD mode work?

A laptop connects to the bar’s USB-B 3.0 port with a single USB cable and holds the meeting in BYOD mode.

06How far do the microphones reach?

The 16-mic array picks up voices at up to 10m. Four expansion microphones can be added for more coverage.

07How many displays can be connected?

The bar has two HDMI outputs, each supporting up to 4K at 60Hz with CEC.

08Does Panel AP30 need its own power supply?

Yes. It uses a 19V 4.5A power adapter, which is included, and it can supply up to 65W to a laptop over USB-C.
